title: carex minor
intro: Carex minor, commonly known as Lesser Crowfoot or Dwarf Sedge, is a perennial aquatic plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. Carex minor contains bioactive constituents such as saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
